faqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
faqPage.lead: Answers about access, Union modules, Settings variables, and support. Use search or the table of contents on the left.

whatIsUnion.title: What is Union?
whatIsUnion.body:
Union is a single panel for multi-page site generation (SoftGen), SEO monitoring (Yandex XML), domain automation (Spaceship + Zomro + SSL + host deploy), and AI token usage.

After sign-in you land on the Dashboard. Each user has private integration keys in Settings — they are not shared between accounts.

access.title: How do I get access?
access.body:
Sign in on the home page with the email and password from your administrator. You will be redirected to /dashboard.

If the password does not work, contact your admin or Telegram support (footer link). Self-registration is not available.

frozenAccount.title: My account is frozen
frozenAccount.body:
If the profile is marked frozen, the session ends after login and the login page shows a frozen-account message.

Contact @rostyslav_sikora on Telegram — an admin can unfreeze or explain the reason.

settingsBasics.title: What is Settings?
settingsBasics.body:
Settings (Dashboard → Settings) stores per-account .env-style variables used by the generator, SEO, domains, SSL, Telegram, and auto-script.

Redis, Supabase URL, and server-only secrets live in the server .env only — not in the Settings UI.

settingsSecrets.title: How are secrets stored?
settingsSecrets.body:
Secret fields (API keys, passwords, tokens) are never returned in API responses — only a “saved” marker.

- Leaving a secret field empty on save keeps the previous value.
- Non-secret fields (host, port, email) are shown as plain text.
- Booleans: 1 = on, 0 = off, empty = unset.

Click Save at the bottom after changes.

settingsSections.title: Settings form sections
settingsSections.body:
The form is grouped like .env blocks:

- Site generator — Claude keys (01…10), model, API base URL (proxy).
- Spaceship — domain registration.
- Zomro — DNS, Billmgr, dnsmgr, SSL TXT records.
- SSL — Let's Encrypt and timing options.
- Host / deploy — SSH, nginx, project directory.
- SEO — Yandex XML positions.
- Telegram — bot reports.
- auto-script-v2 — post-generation webhook.

See Documentation for each variable.

generator.title: Generator FAQ
generator.body:
Minimum: CLAUDE_API_KEY_01 (sk-ant-…) under Settings → Generator.

- Keys 02…10 — parallel builds.
- ANTHROPIC_MODEL, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (optional proxy).
- Build mode (templates, SOFTGEN_*) is set in the server .env, not in Settings.

Token issues — Usage page.

seo.title: SEO FAQ
seo.body:
In SEO, add a domain and keywords, run position checks, export CSV.

Set YANDEX_XML_STOCK_BASE_URL under Settings → SEO. Without it, position checks will not work.

SEO domains are scoped per user account.

domains.title: Domains and SSL
domains.body:
Domain automation uses Spaceship, Zomro, SSL (Let's Encrypt), and optional SSH deploy.

Fill the matching Settings blocks first. ZOMRO_DNSMGR_ENABLED=1 enables dnsmgr; SSL_LETSENCRYPT_EMAIL is required for production certificates.

Change SSL timing variables only if you understand DNS delays.

usage.title: Usage and AI tokens
usage.body:
Usage lists Claude/DeepSeek spend per generation job with search and status filter (30 rows per page).

If generation fails on API limits, verify Claude keys in Settings and your Anthropic quota.

support.title: Support
support.body:
Telegram: @rostyslav_sikora (footer link on dashboard, FAQ, and docs).

Include your account email, module name, and error time for faster troubleshooting.

docsPage.title: Documentation
docsPage.lead: Step-by-step Union modules and Settings variables. Search and the left contents jump to each topic.

overview.title: Platform overview
overview.body:
Union includes:

- Generator — multi-page sites from a brief.
- SEO — keywords, Yandex positions, CSV export.
- Domains — registration, DNS, SSL, VPS deploy.
- Usage — AI token accounting.
- Settings — personal .env variables.

Recommended order: Settings → test generator → SEO/domains as needed.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.body:
After sign-in, the Dashboard page (e.g. /uk/dashboard or /en/dashboard) shows module cards. Access depends on role (user / admin).

The header has email, UI language (uk/en/ru), and sign out. Admins may see extra user management when enabled.

generator.title: Generator module
generator.body:
Open Generator from the Dashboard. Set site folder (slug), theme/semantics, page count, optional base URL, then Start build.

Track job status and download ZIP when finished. Cancel stops the pipeline.

Claude keys in Settings are required (see below).

seo.title: SEO module
seo.body:
Add a domain, manage keywords, run position checks, export CSV.

Configure YANDEX_XML_STOCK_BASE_URL in Settings → SEO. The URL depends on your Yandex XML Stock provider.

Domains are isolated per user_id.

domains.title: Domains and automation
domains.body:
The Domain module runs registration (Spaceship), DNS (Zomro), SSL, and optional host deploy.

Typical chain: Spaceship → DNS A record to SUBDOMAIN_HOST_IP → ACME TXT → SSL → nginx deploy if SUBDOMAIN_HOST_SSL_DEPLOY=1.

Telegram reports need TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.

usage.title: Usage (AI tokens)
usage.body:
Dashboard → Usage: generations table with tokens and cost. Search by slug/model, filter by status, 30 rows per page.

Useful after changing ANTHROPIC_MODEL or page count in the brief.

settingsOverview.title: Settings — general rules
settingsOverview.body:
Path: Dashboard → Settings (/dashboard/settings).

- Field names match process.env keys.
- Save calls PUT /api/settings/integration → account_integration_settings.
- Secrets are write-only in UI; empty secret field means “keep existing”.
- Booleans: 1 / 0 / empty.
- If you see a migration warning, run the SQL in Supabase and reload.

Sections below list variables by form group.

settingsGenerator.title: Settings — generator (Claude / SoftGen)
settingsGenerator.body:
Site generator (per-account):

- CLAUDE_API_KEY_01 … 10 — Anthropic keys.
- ANTHROPIC_MODEL, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL — model and API.
- ANTHROPIC_MAX_TOKENS_PAGE, ANTHROPIC_MAX_TOKENS_ARCHITECT, AURORA_CLAUDE_SITE_OUTPUT_BUDGET — Claude token limits.
- SOFTGEN_MIN_PAGE_WORDS, SOFTGEN_MIN_INDEX_PAGE_WORDS, SOFTGEN_MAX_PAGE_WORDS — word count in page main content.
- AURORA_GENERATION_TEMPERATURE — model temperature (quality vs variety).
- SOFTGEN_QUALITY_REGEN_ENABLED — retry page when text is too short or too similar.
- SOFTGEN_SOURCE_ARTICLES_* — reference texts from Supabase source_articles (language, count, pool size).

Other SOFTGEN_* (etalons) — server `.env` (see `.env.example`).

settingsSpaceshipZomro.title: Settings — Spaceship and Zomro
settingsSpaceshipZomro.body:
Spaceship: SPACESHIP_API_KEY, SPACESHIP_API_SECRET, SPACESHIP_CONTACT_ID.

Zomro: ZOMRO_AUTH_TOKEN or ZOMRO_USERNAME + ZOMRO_PASSWORD; ZOMRO_AUTH_THROUGH_KEY, ZOMRO_AUTHINFO; ZOMRO_BILLMGR_*; ZOMRO_DNSMGR_URL, ZOMRO_DNSMGR_DOMAIN_EMAIL; ZOMRO_DNSMGR_ENABLED, ZOMRO_API_DNS_ENABLED; ZOMRO_DNSMGR_TXT_CREATE_FUNC / TXT_DELETE_FUNC.

settingsSslHost.title: Settings — SSL and host
settingsSslHost.body:
SSL: SSL_LETSENCRYPT_EMAIL (required for prod), SSL_LETSENCRYPT_STAGING, SSL_LETSENCRYPT_SKIP_VERIFY, SSL_ASYNC_RETRY_MS, SSL_MIN_AUTHORITATIVE_NS_READY, SSL_DNS_CHALLENGE_REMOVE_DELAY_MS, SSL_DELEGATION_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS, SSL_DELEGATION_WAIT_POLL_MS, SSL_ZOMRO_DNS_POST_DELAY_MS.

Host: SUBDOMAIN_HOST_IP, SUBDOMAIN_HOST_USER, SUBDOMAIN_HOST_PASSWORD, SUBDOMAIN_HOST_PORT, SUBDOMAIN_HOST_SSL_DEPLOY, SUBDOMAIN_HOST_PROJECTS_DIR, SUBDOMAIN_HOST_NGINX_*, SUBDOMAIN_HOST_NGINX_PHP.

settingsSeoTelegram.title: Settings — SEO and Telegram
settingsSeoTelegram.body:
SEO: YANDEX_XML_STOCK_BASE_URL.

Telegram: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET, TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME, cleanup-related TELEGRAM_* vars, CRON_SECRET / TELEGRAM_BOT_CLEANUP_CRON_SECRET.

settingsAutoscript.title: Settings — auto-script-v2
settingsAutoscript.body:
AUTOSCRIPT_WEBHOOK_URL — POST URL after a successful generation.
AUTOSCRIPT_WEBHOOK_SECRET — shared header secret.

Leave empty if you do not use the webhook.

workflow.title: Recommended workflow
workflow.body:
1. Sign in with admin-provided credentials.
2. Settings: Claude key + Spaceship/Zomro/SSL/host as needed.
3. Test build (1 site, few pages), download ZIP.
4. Check Usage for token spend.
5. Enable SEO or Domain automation.
6. Optional: Telegram and AUTOSCRIPT webhook.

For errors, note time, job slug, and contact @rostyslav_sikora.
